en: Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a broad curved square lined with multi-storey buildings and shops, tram tracks running through the middle, pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, and mountains in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the view as Place Grenette and the Saint-Eynard mountain in Grenoble. Shop signs and advertising (including one reading "RATAFIA") are visible along the right side.
